cards.card_text: Jacob tells them, “I will go down to Sheol mourning for my son.” So Joseph's father weeps for him, and friend, I think this one hurts.
cards.verse_text: All his sons and daughters tried to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted. “No,” he said. “I will go down to Sheol mourning for my son.” So his father wept for him.
